keywordTitle: Find the topics of each chat from the words of its title, of its first messages, of the folders of its files, and of its issues and pull requests
languageModelTitle: Find the topics of each chat with a language model: the coding agent codex or claude that is installed on this computer
keywordHelp: The topics of each chat come from the words of its title, of the first messages that you typed, of the folders of the files that the coding agent wrote, and of the titles of its issues and pull requests. Nothing leaves this computer.
languageModelHelp: A language model finds the topics. Heidrun Code sends the title and the first messages that you typed, of the chats that the list shows, and nothing else, to the coding agent codex or claude that is installed on this computer.
clusteredWhatHelp: A clustered dynamic topic is the name of a group of dynamic topics that have a close meaning, so one subject has one label.
clusteredSentHelp: Heidrun Code sends only the short labels of the raw dynamic topics, and never the text of a chat, to the coding agent codex or claude that is installed on this computer.
clusteredOffHelp: Heidrun Code shows the raw dynamic topics and makes no call.
rebuildTitle: Empty the translation table, and cluster all the raw dynamic topics again, in one call
error.noCodingAgent: Neither codex nor claude is installed on this computer, so Heidrun Code shows the raw dynamic topics.
error.failed: The coding agent did not answer, so Heidrun Code shows the raw dynamic topics for now. Heidrun Code tries again when the topics change, and at the next start.
error.wrongAnswer: The coding agent gave an answer that Heidrun Code cannot use, so Heidrun Code saved nothing and shows the raw dynamic topics for now. Heidrun Code tries again when the topics change, and at the next start.
languageModelError.noCodingAgent: Neither codex nor claude is installed on this computer, so the language model finds no topic.
languageModelError.failed: The coding agent did not answer, so the language model found no new topic for now. Heidrun Code tries again when the chats change, and at the next start.
languageModelError.wrongAnswer: The coding agent gave an answer that Heidrun Code cannot use, so Heidrun Code saved nothing for now. Heidrun Code tries again when the chats change, and at the next start.
